en: Job 10

p.src: 1  “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

en: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
u.src: 1  “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

p.src: 2  I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

en: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
u.src: 2  I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

p.src: 3  Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

en: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
u.src: 3  Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

p.src: 4  Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

en: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
u.src: 4  Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

p.src: 5  Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

en: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
u.src: 5  Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

p.src: 6  that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

en: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
u.src: 6  that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

p.src: 7  Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

en: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
u.src: 7  Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

p.src: 8  “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

en: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
u.src: 8  “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

p.src: 9  Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

en: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
u.src: 9  Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

p.src: 10  Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

en: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
u.src: 10  Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

p.src: 11  You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

en: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
u.src: 11  You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

p.src: 12  You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

en: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
u.src: 12  You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

p.src: 13  Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

en: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
u.src: 13  Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

p.src: 14  if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

en: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
u.src: 14  if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

p.src: 15  If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

en: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
u.src: 15  If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

p.src: 16  If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

en: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
u.src: 16  If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

p.src: 17  You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

en: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
u.src: 17  You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

p.src: 18  “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

en: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
u.src: 18  “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

p.src: 19  I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

en: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
u.src: 19  I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

p.src: 20  Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort, 21  before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

zh: 我的日子不是甚少嗎？ 求你停手寬容我， 叫我在往而不返之先－ 就是往黑暗和死蔭之地以先－ 可以稍得暢快。
en: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
u.src: 20  Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort, 21  before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

p.src: 22  the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

en: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
u.src: 22  the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
